book_context: Late in the book, after an omitted chapter of travel and silence, Adams reaches sixty while his closest friends hold power. John Hay is ambassador in London and then Secretary of State; Lodge is a Senator; Roosevelt follows. Clarence King and Hay are declining. The recurring mechanisms carry forward: 'a friend in power is a friend lost'; sitting on the steps of Ara Coeli; Pteraspis, Lyell and Limulus from the Darwinism chapter; women and the Virgin as force; and the search for unity against multiplicity, now recast as attempts to measure history mechanically. These chapters move from diplomatic triumph to the dynamo and the Virgin, then to magnets, geology and Russian inertia. They prepare the formal 'Dynamic Theory' and the 'Law of Acceleration'. Omitted chapters (Chicago, Silence, Grant, Eccentricity) leave some setup that must be glossed locally: Hay sent to London; the dynamos first seen at Chicago in 1893.
continuity_checks: The party is credited to Bay Lodge and Stickney, with Adams and Bay Lodge as its only two members.
'The Senator' is Lodge; the Lodges go to Berlin, Adams to Stockholm.
McKinley's assassination attempt is read in Stockholm and his death reported en route to Hammerfest; the date of reaching Hammerfest is September 14.
Teufelsdrockh is identified as Carlyle's figure of 1830.

essential: Paris as the only universal school, now chaotic beyond him (science and mathematics past his horizon). Companions: Joe Stickney, Bay Lodge and his wife. His resolve never to fall behind.
He abandons youthful amusements; a man 'holding open the door into the next world' takes a last glance at this one.

Mrs. Lodge summons him; Rothenburg and Baireuth. In 1901 Baireuth's rococo jars, and New York and Paris understand Wagner's catastrophe better: Paris coquets with catastrophe and New York meets it with horror. Ternina and the Fluch-motif.

Bay Lodge and Stickney's party of Conservative Christian Anarchists. Keep its comic dialectics: exactly two members, Adams and Bay Lodge, each denying the other. Keep the doctrine: order and anarchy one, the unity chaos, and the duty to accelerate and concentrate force. Kropotkin and Reclus are dismissed as disguised believers in order.
He admits the darkness: the throb of doubling steam horse-power drowns rhyme and reason. The Senator leads him to Russia, since a Senator is indispensable there.

Americans are all CCAs by nature; Russia is the opposite. The images: the Polish Jew at the station and the peasant kissing the ikon; radium with negative luminosity; nomads stopped in their wanderings; a sink of energy; one peasant serving for a hundred million.

Can race-inertia be changed? De Witte and Khilkoff's immense efforts are uncertain; Russia lags since 1898. The Senator would allow more than three generations; Adams says nothing (opinion founded on fact must be error). He avoids Berlin and goes to Stockholm.

Russia as three-fourths of humanity, perhaps the true movement against America's hasty acceleration. La Fontaine's monkey and bear: keep the French lines, or paraphrase them and keep the 'monkey and motor afraid of the bear'.
The ice-cap image: Russian inertia as a glacier wall from the Baltic to the Black Sea. Race rules conditions, yet no one knows what race is.

Through Sweden to Norway and Hammerfest on September 14. Electric light at the edge of the polar ice where Carlyle's Teufelsdrockh once questioned the infinite. News of the attempt on McKinley, read in Stockholm, then of his death, arrives day by day: acceleration in the lines of unity upsets his philosophy for a moment.
The ne plus ultra; his Norse fishermen ancestors caught between ice and Russian inertia; a permanent line of division.

South through Kiel, Hamburg and Cologne: a new Germany of coal, the Rhine like Birmingham, Cologne Cathedral 'of Chicago'. In 1858 Russia was felt; in 1901 only coal, the empire of Coal from Hammerfest to Norfolk. Beyond it Russia holds by inertia. Hay stands in Russia's path over China, safe as long as de Witte rules.

title: TEUFELSDROCKH (1901)

verbatim.purpose: Elderly resolve with an ironic twist.
verbatim.text: His single thought was to keep in front of the movement, and, if necessary, lead it to chaos, but never fall behind. Only the young have time to linger in the rear.

verbatim.purpose: Closing aphorism on Wagner and catastrophe.
verbatim.text: Flattery had lost its charm, but the Fluch-motif went home.

verbatim.purpose: Core doctrine of the conservative Christian anarchist.
verbatim.text: Adams proclaimed that in the last synthesis, order and anarchy were one, but that the unity was chaos.
Russia became luminous like the salt of radium; but with a negative luminosity as though she were a substance whose energies had been sucked out--an inert residuum--with movement of pure inertia.
For him, all opinion founded on fact must be error, because the facts can never be complete, and their relations must be always infinite.
and there the newer Teufelsdrockh sat dumb with surprise, and glared at the permanent electric lights of Hammerfest.

verbatim.purpose: Wry verdict on hearing of McKinley within the Arctic night.
verbatim.text: The electro-dynamo-social universe worked better than the sun.
one great empire was ruled by one great emperor--Coal.

voice_profile: Third-person autobiography in which the elderly Adams treats his younger and present self with ironic detachment ('Adams', 'one', 'the student', 'the tourist', 'an insect', 'the monkey'). Long periodic sentences turn on qualification and paradox. Cosmic science metaphors (force, mass, inertia, triangulation, attraction) are applied to politics and friendship. He undercuts himself constantly through self-deprecation and mock-pedantry. He flatly refuses certainty ('knew no more than...'). Aphoristic closers end paragraphs. Foreign tags and verse quotations act as punctuation. Grief appears only obliquely, through restraint and stage-images. Double hyphens mark interruption and accumulation.
